consequences: PLAN Phase 7; hosted mode (Phase 6) is the access path for people without a terminal.
context: The owner wants office, events and marketing teams to use sati too.
decision: Add a general project kind and human-first fields (due date, assignees, checklist, comments) to the same core instead of a separate edition. Assignees are long-lived ownership; claims stay short agent leases. Plain words only in the UI; CLI and MCP terms stay. No bundled model: an ask tool returns ranked records for the caller's assistant.
title: Team brain: one product with project kinds, assignees separate from claims
